scenario: Customer Avery reserves New Year's Day dinner for 4 at Osteria Lume in Houston, during the Houston trip. One static restaurant, hard-coded hours and tables; no restaurant API and no table is really held. All data is fictional.

customer.name: Avery Morgan
customer.balanceNote: The designs start from Day 1's 12,450 points (same as Day 2). The mock must track the real balance: whichever of Day 2 or Day 3 runs second sees what's left. To demo Points only for a $400 deposit, seed 52,450.

restaurant.name: Osteria Lume
restaurant.about: Chef Livia Montarro cooks everything over an open hearth: wood-roasted vegetables, hand-made pasta and whole fish, finished at the table.
restaurant.menuNote: Vegetarian and gluten-free swaps on request.

setup.note: Hard-coded seed data for the POC: no inventory tool or admin screen.
setup.fitRule: A table fits when its size >= party size. Show only start times whose table fits; 3 guests can't take a 2-top; parties of 5-6 fit only the 6:00 and 9:00 PM 6-tops.
setup.seatingNote: Assumption used for the overlap rule: a reservation occupies 2 hours from its start time.

seededBookingsByOtherGuests.note: So the demo shows a range of counts and one Sold out. Tables left = 5 - confirmed bookings at that time.

trip.title: Your trip in Houston
trip.linkRule: Link the reservation to the trip whose dates include the reservation date (the hotel booked on Day 2). Use the trip ID when there is one.

reservationRequest.idempotencyKey: uuid generated when Review opens; reused on retries

reservationResult.idFormat: RES-<yymmdd of the reservation date>-<4 characters from A-Z and 2-9, without O, I, 0 or 1>

policy.text: Cancel by Wed, Dec 30, 8:00 PM (48 hours before) for a full refund. After that, the deposit isn't refunded.

validation.name: required
validation.overlap: block when the customer already has a confirmed reservation on the same date whose 2-hour seating overlaps the new one

overlapDemo.note: Turn on in the mock to show D3-Closed-3b-Details-Errors

getAvailability.returns: the fitting start times with tablesLeft

order: create reservation and lower that time's count

scenarios.paymentDeclined: card fails: no reservation, no count change, no points deducted
scenarios.soldOutAtConfirm: tablesLeft hit 0 since the customer chose the time: nothing charged; send them back to times

createReservation.idempotency: a repeat request with the same idempotencyKey returns the first result and changes nothing

imageKeys.note: Images already in the project from Day 1 (design/assets). Artboards reference them as /_blob/<id>.
